title: A pullback coefficient map extends to an effacing square
statement: For a scheme map g:Y to X with X quasi compact and separated, and a map from the tensor pullback of a quasicoherent F to a quasicoherent G, there is a commuting square of short exact sequences with first terms F,G, quasicoherent middle and last terms, and acyclic source middle term. The square includes the induced maps on tensor pullbacks of the middle and quotient terms. The conventions and constructions are those of [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text:
Choose the universally monic affine-cover acyclic embedding i:F into E.
Set Q=coker(i). Tensor pullback is a left adjoint and preserves cokernels,
and its image of i is monic by the embedding's universal property. Push this
image out along psi, obtaining G into E'. Pushouts of monomorphisms are monic
in an abelian category. Set Q'=coker(G into E'). The pushout is quasi-coherent:
it is the cokernel of the map from g*F to g*E direct sum G. Its cokernel Q'
is quasi-coherent too. The cokernel comparison for tensor pullback and the
universal property of cokernels provide g*Q into Q'. These choices give both
commuting squares and the two short exact sequences. Acyclicity of E is the
one supplied by the finite affine cover, including an empty cover.

proof_origin.place: Structural adjunction formulas and simultaneous effacement proof of normalized pullback naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pullbackEffacingSquare (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated] (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G) : Nonempty (PullbackEffacingSquare g F G ψ)
